answer: Propose one AI vote/key/day on blasting a quartz ledge versus protecting a pearl farm. Each key needs a human sponsor at a daily 30-minute live check. Registrars jointly deduplicate biometrics; ledger validators check signed, key-bound tickets and allow one key per sponsor/day. Failed checks or reused tickets deny the vote. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse sponsors. Hardware is reusable; human time recurs; no stake is locked. Corrupt registrars or biometric errors break uniqueness; rich owners can hire sponsors. Ten keys need ten people: 10 x 30 minutes = 5 person-hours/day.
